paragraphs: Rav Shmuel bar Natan said in R' Hanina's name: Shabbat 38a; Bekhorot 11, end of side a; Avodah Zarah 74a. This is also the correct reading in Sukkah 43b. In R' Hama bar Hanina's name: Jerusalem Berakhot, first chapter, mishnah 8, and Shabbat, Kirah, halakhah 1. He went up to R' Yehoshua ben Levi: Yom ha-Kippurim, halakhah 1.
